profile.name: KRISHNA CHAITANYA BHUPATHI RAJU
profile.title: Data Analyst
profile.bio: Data Analyst with 3+ years of experience using SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and advanced analytics across financial, operational, and healthcare data. Experienced in ETL/ELT, data quality, data governance, data modeling, data pipelines, KPI reporting, and stakeholder collaboration. Designed TIDE-HF, a clinical analytics system achieving 0.78–0.98 AUROC across 11 adverse-event classifiers using 546K+ MIMIC-IV admissions. Skilled in PySpark, Apache Spark, AWS, Databricks, statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning within Agile environments
